column1: # The metrics calculated by calculate-metrics.sh, in the order they are displayed.
# This file is read by calculate-metrics.sh, update-dashboard-issue.py and update-language-issues.py.
# - id: the name of the result files: check-pages[.<language>]/<id>.txt per language and <id>.txt for the total.
# - languages: "all" or "translations" (the metric doesn't apply to English).
# - source: "check-pages" (written by check-pages.sh) or the name of a result of a tldr script, filtered per language.
# - denominator: the variable in calculate-metrics.sh with the total the percentage is calculated on, or "-".
# - link: how a result is linked in the dashboards: "reference" (link the page mentioned in the result),
#   "edit" (edit the page), "new" (create the page), "lint" (link the line of the page) or "none".
# - label: the description of the metric, used in the output and dashboards.
